narrationTexts: I'll start by exploring the codebase.
finalText:
**1082 hits, 94 files. Four zones must keep `account_id`.**

| Zone | Hits | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `migrations/` | 61 | Applied history. Needs a new migration. |
| SQL strings in `repo/` | ~200 | Real DB column name. |
| [docs/openapi.yaml](docs/openapi.yaml) | 5 | Public contract. Breaking change. |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk/` | 20 | Generated. Refresh overwrites it. |

[lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8) maps internal to wire. Keep the right side. The other ~795 hits are plain JS names. Those are safe.

Next: get a column rename migration, or ship the JS half only.
